name: LangGraph Server
description: REST server hosting compiled LangGraph agents (assistants, threads, runs, persistent state, store), Postgres + Redis.
fingerprint_note: GET /ok returns {"ok":true}; GET /info present; POST /assistants/search + /threads/search + /store/items are LangGraph-unique. Auth is opt-in (@auth.authenticate); Studio-origin requests bypass even configured auth. dev=2024 binds 127.0.0.1.
dork_notes: Shodan-BANNER-dark by construction (confirmed 2026-06-19 round-2, primary-source markers): port:8123 "langgraph_py_version"=0, "search_assistants_assistants_search_post" (openapi operationId)=0 — Shodan crawls / and never fetches /info or /openapi.json where the discriminating markers live. http.html:"LangGraph"=590 but pure freetext collision (Galent/NewRelic/PaellaDoc product+marketing pages embed the framework name; real servers return {"ok":true} JSON at /, not HTML). dev=2024 binds 127.0.0.1 (lo-dark); docker `langgraph up` publishes host 8123->container 8000 on 0.0.0.0 (reachable but banner-dark). Engine route: Censys / active-probe, NOT Shodan HTML dorking.
severity_note: Unauth = provider + LANGSMITH keys (worker env), graph/tool defs, full agent memory (threads state/history, store/items, often PII), code-exec via POST /runs against custom-node assistants.
exposure_data: provider+LANGSMITH keys, graph/tool definitions, thread state/history (PII), store items, run code-exec
sources: CANDIDATE:  cat-agent-platforms survey 2026-06-19. Round-1: 14 freetext candidates 0/14 verified (catch-all SPAs). Round-2: primary-source markers (langgraph_py_version, search_assistants operationId) all 0 — Shodan-BANNER-dark by construction (markers in /info & /openapi.json, never crawled). Not Shodan-selectable; route to Censys/active-probe. Agent surfaced candidate CVE IDs (unverified, not codified).
